Question: Oxygenation
Possible Answers: Oxygen saturation on room air greater than 92 percent | Oxygen saturation on supplemental oxygen greater than or equal to 90 percent | Oxygen saturation on supplemental oxygen less than 90 percent

Question: Respiration
Possible Answers: Able to breathe deeply and cough freely | Dyspnea or limited breathing | Apnea or requires mechanical ventilation

Question: Circulation
Possible Answers: Blood pressure within 20 percent of preanesthetic level | Blood pressure 20-49 percent from preanesthetic level | Blood pressure 50 percent or more from preanesthetic level

Question: Activity
Possible Answers: Able to move all four limbs | Able to move two limbs | Unable to move limbs voluntarily or on command
